family_summary: Across the layout family, AI-built pages typically replace the originals' floats, flexbox-only or sidebar structures with flex-plus-grid layouts in a centered column of roughly 1040–1120px with full-bleed bands. Hero areas are most often rebuilt as two-column text-and-image or gradient heroes, spacing becomes regular, and page height most often changes, usually becoming shorter.
